verdicts.title: Topological aspects of Boolean functions
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We discuss ways in which tools from topology can be used to derive lower bounds for the circuit complexity of Boolean functions.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract addresses topology for circuit complexity lower bounds, not communication complexity, and makes no mention of Čech complexes, Euler characteristics, or the Θ(C(n)) relationship claimed in the conjecture.
